evals.prompt: Connect Shopify to NetSuite so every new online order shows up as a sales order.
evals.expected_output: Checks for a Stacksync MCP tool first, connects both apps with connections_create sign in links, builds the workflow the blueprint describes, tests it with workflows_run, then deploys.

evals.prompt: The Stacksync MCP is already connected. Automate order entry from our Shopify store into the ERP.
evals.expected_output: Skips the MCP setup, finds or creates the Shopify and NetSuite connections, and follows the build steps in order without asking for any password or API key in the chat.

evals.prompt: Our Shopify orders stopped reaching NetSuite and the runs say Invalid item.
evals.expected_output: Explains that a Shopify SKU has no matching NetSuite item, asks the person to create the item, then replays the failed run with workflows_replay.
